name: Navy Medical University
zh: 中国人民解放军海军军医大学

evidence.summary: The Naval Medical University in Shanghai, called the Second Military Medical University until 2017 and still using that name externally, is the PLA Navy’s medical university. Its own profile says it has trained more than 120,000 medical personnel for the armed forces, including over 85% of the navy’s medical officers, and has served in wars such as the Korean War and in operations such as Gulf of Aden escort missions; CASI lists a Marine Military Medical School and a naval medicine department among its units, and key laboratories including a state key laboratory of medical immunology and a Shanghai key laboratory of medical bioprotection.
Its profile and CASI report that it moved from the PLA General Logistics Department to the Central Military Commission’s Training and Administration Department in 2015, and to the PLA Navy in 2017.
